title: Wearable Lily Pad
description: This mod allows you to wear a lily pad upon your head.
body:
This mod allows you to wear a lily pad on your head. You have to put a regular lily pad in a crafting grid to get the wearable one.


![How to craft wearable lily pad](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5363cf1d124b4be62a93028d59ffaeb4b698d4b5_0.webp)


The wearable lily pad can not be converted back to a normal lily pad. The lily pad provides one armor point. It is unenchantable. This is one of my first mods, it may have some bugs. I am unaware of any incompatibilities.
